note: The Hollow's fighting numbers (H0, the move arena, approved by Matt October 27, 2026; docs/future/16-the-sea-cave.md, Fighting, The lantern, The bestiary). Loaded by tools/move-arena.html?course=hollow only until H3; nothing in the game reads it yet. camera: the walker camera's numbers below ground (as recipes/world/walker.json camera), higher and further back so the floor reads; fade: walls and pillars between the eye and the walker (or the locked target) fade to fillAlpha with a soft outline instead of the camera pulling in; lockFrame: while locked, the view aims frameShare of the way from you to the target and turns to keep both in view at turnPerS (a share a second), sideDeg off the line between you so you never stand in front of it; the mouse still nudges it. lantern: fuel (a full lantern), burnPerS as it hangs and raisedBurnPerS while the right mouse holds it up, sipFuel what one hit costs (a sip), reachM how far its light reaches (raisedReachM held up, emberReachM snuffed), glintM how far past the light a thing still glints (lockable), ambient the chamber's own light (a share), strength the lantern's light on the page, raiseS how long the lantern takes to come up. lock: outOfReachS, how long a locked thing may stay out of the light before the lock drops. dot: the floor dot's range from the camera's tilt, farM at levelDeg (the camera's least tilt) and nearM at downDeg (its most), stepM how finely it walks the grid. swing: the staff's reach (m, from the walker's middle) and arc (degrees, centred ahead); sideDeg and backDeg: a hit from more than this off a thing's front counts as on its side, or its back. chains (Matt, October 27, 2026: one swing a click, chaining to the second and third): each combo clip cut into single swings round its strikes (segments, seconds of the clip; hits, the strike in each, found from the arm's speed peaks), played speed times faster; the walker stands anchored while one plays; a click during a swing chains the next, which starts chainAfterHitS after this one's hit lands; a click within chainWindowS after a swing ends also chains; otherwise it starts again from the first. hitStopS: the moment the world holds still when a hit lands; easeS: how quickly a swing blends in and out. hurt (Matt: no stunlocks): a hit on the walker staggers for staggerS (the hit clip played over clipS, no control), shoved shoveM along the blow over shoveS (over the walk grid, never into rock), then for graceS no strike lands. foes: the stand-ins' steps (rest, notice, close in, wind-up, strike, recover), timed from doc 16's table: noticeM, closeMps, strikeM (how near before the wind-up), windS (the tell), strikeS, dashM (a lunge's reach), hitM (how near a strike must end to land), recoverS (the opening), hp (hits to break), frontDeg (an armored front), size (small or large, for Taproot), instinct (the one the moves press on: movement, strikes at movement; toward, goes toward light; shy, shies from light), floats (off the floor, so Groundline passes under it), knockM (how far a landed hit knocks it back) bodyM (its body's radius, for the crowd: things keep this far apart) bounceM and recoilS (a lunge that hits the walker stops at contact, bounces back bounceM and recoils for recoilS before it is stuck) and flinchS (how long it flinches: a hit breaks its wind-up or its lunge; a glance off the armored front only nudges it and breaks a wind-up). The watcher's callM: how far its call carries; turnDegPerS its slow turn. The motes keep out of the raised lantern's reach by keepOutM and dart in to nip.

enemySpace.note: Matt's nTop enemy space is to scale across the enemies (H2, October 27, 2026): mPerUnit is metres per nTop unit, the factor that makes the soot mote 20 cm across (its longest side, 49.17 units). Every enemy's prep script (tools/hollow-prep/) scales by it, so they keep their sizes to each other.

crowd.note: How the Hollow's things share the walker (H2, Matt, October 27, 2026; src/world/hollow/crowd.js). attackSlots: at most this many may close in and wind up at once (gentleSlots in the gentler Hollow); a crawler wants a slot from noticing you, motes and a watcher only once ready to strike; turns go round in a queue (those coming together nearest first, one that has had its turn to the back), and a slot frees when its holder recovers, gives up or breaks. The rest wait on a ring ringM from the walker (each a seeded share of ringSpreadM further), at least spreadDeg apart round it, facing you, drifting there at driftShare of their closing pace. Bodies (foes.*.bodyM, a mote cluster one body) closer than their radii are pushed apart, pushPerS of the overlap a second (as a share eased by the frame); a thing winding up, striking, stuck after it, stunned or knocked back holds its ground and the other takes the whole push (two holding share it); floating things only space against floating things. walkerBodyM: the walker's own body: a lunge stops when it touches it and bounces off (rolling clear dodges it), and the push keeps things out of it (one holding its ground stays put; the walker may still walk through things, Matt's call).

crawler.note: The silt crawler as drawn (H2, Matt's model from nTop, October 27, 2026; tools/hollow-prep/crawler.py makes assets/models/hollow/crawler.glb from his OBJs at enemySpace.mPerUnit, with its rig in code). prep (read by the prep script; remake the model after changing): stalkMidM, how near the middle line the body's own top is read; stalkAboveM, how far above that a stalk starts; stalkBlendM, the stalk's blend out of the body; stalkReachM, how far fore and aft of a stalk the body still follows it; knobShare, how far up a stalk its knob starts; plateFromM, the shell plate from this far forward (m, a soft edge); plateFacing, and facing at least this far forward; seamFromM and seamFullM, how far a point sits in from its neighbours (m) to count as down in a seam between Matt's modelled cobbles ; cobbleBelowM, a point sitting in by less than this is on a cobble (cobbles are joined along the mesh into one each, each its own shade); bellyNormal, the underside where the surface faces down this much; bellyBelowM, below this height on the body; kneeBlendShare, how much of a leg the knee blend spans, so the straight tubes curve; tailBlendShare, each tail joint's blend; tailRootShare, how much of the tail's root end follows the root. look (lib-crawler.wgsl; no textures, Matt's OBJs have no UVs, so the surfaces are drawn from where each point is): silt, packed wet silt (linear), with a grain grainShare deep at grainM across and a wet sheen (wetRoughness, wetSheen); shell, the plate's shells (Matt's modelled cobbles), each its own shade by up to shadeJitter, with silt packed into the seams (seamShare: how much of a seam's depth the silt fills); belly, the soft pale underside; knob, the eye knobs, glowNits their faint light in the dark; flash, how pale a landed hit flashes it; spark, a glance's sparks. motion (crawler-motion.js): breath (a share, at hz); crouchM, how far the body sits down on its legs so the knees bend; gait: a foot belongs tuckShare of the way from its hip to where Matt modelled it (his legs are straight, so this bends the knees and gives the feet room); it steps when it is strideM from there (further at speed, never past what its leg can reach), over stepS (quicker at speed, a scurry), lifted liftM, landing leadShare of a stride ahead, never more than two at once (diagonal pairs); the plate bobs plateBobM and plateBobDeg a step. tell (the rear-up, over the foe's windS): the front rises rearDeg about the hind hips in riseS, lifted riseM, the forelegs lift foreLiftDeg, with a quiver (quiverDeg at quiverHz). lunge: plate first, the front dips diveDeg, the forelegs reach reachDeg forward and the hind legs drive back. bounce: a lunge that meets the walker rocks the front back recoilDeg as it bounces off. stuck (the foe's recoverS): the plate digs digDeg into the silt, sunk sinkM, the back up and soft, struggling struggleDeg at struggleHz, pulling free over the last freeS. glance: a front hit sparks (sparks of them, sparkSizeM, at sparkMps, lasting sparkS) and rocks the front back recoilDeg over s. flinch: a side or back hit jerks it flinchDeg away and squashes it squash, over s. tail: a spring (stiffness, damping) lagging behind the body's turns, a slow sway (swayDeg at swayHz), and now and then at rest a curl to one side (curlDeg, every curlEveryS give or take curlJitterS, seeded). stalks: a bob (bobDeg at bobHz), turning to look at the walker up to lookDeg at lookRate, and a seeded twitch now and then at rest (twitchDeg over twitchS, every twitchEveryS give or take twitchJitterS). breakup (doc 16: grey sand and motes of light, not a body): it slumps over slumpS into sand grains (sand of them, sizeM, flung at mps, settling and fading over lifeS) while motes of light rise (motes of them at riseMps, sizeM, glowNits, over lifeS).

stone.note: The hagstone watcher as drawn (H2, Matt approved the orchestrator's draft 2, October 27, 2026). prep: what tools/hollow-prep/watcher.mjs builds assets/models/hollow/watcher.glb from (a signed field in Y-up metres, the hole looking along +Z, the origin at the stone's middle): a lopsided flattened pebble (radiiM, leaned by leanShare, its lower half thickened by bulgeShare, worn by wearM of noise at wearFreq), an off-centre hole (rM, flaring by flareShare toward the faces, its rim softened over blendM), a barnacle crust on the lower left only (count shells of rM, each a ring with a pit pitShare deep, clear of the hole by clearM), four flat wrack blades from the underside (lengthsM, a seeded bend and twist, halfM wide, frilled, segments a blade, bones a blade for the sway), the albedo (linear base colour; the palette paints later), the field meshed at cellM then cut by quadric edge collapse to targetTris (fineCellM is the draft's own cell, for the before-and-after), and the albedo and the fine field's normals baked into textureSize maps over an xatlas unwrap. look: the hole's light (linear colour, cooler at rest and warmer as it notices; cd/m2 for each state: resting and breathing, noticing, the tell's peak, the call's pulse, dimmed by Snuff or Unmade; how far it reaches up the walls, how much it lights the polished rim and the floor, and the soft glow filling the opening: haloShare radii across, haloGain its strength). motion: the float (hover over the ground, a bob, a drift, a slow roll, a tilt to look at the light), the weed's lagging springs (stiffness, damping, its own slow current, how far it streams from the stone's movement and turn, how far it flares in the tell), the call (a pulse, a ring of light on the floor), a flinch, and breaking (it drops to the floor, the light goes out, grit and motes of light).

mote.note: One soot mote as drawn (H2, Matt's model from nTop, October 27, 2026; tools/hollow-prep/mote.py makes assets/models/hollow/mote.glb from his OBJ at sizeM across). sizeM: across (m), at the island's findable scale, erring bigger; heightM how high a mote floats over the floor. albedo: soot, linear; fuzz: the soot's soft sheen at grazing angles (a share of the light), so its edge reads against the dark. eyes: pale (albedo, linear), glowNits their faint light in the dark, blinkEveryS (give or take blinkJitterS, seeded per mote) and blinkS; widen: how much rounder and bigger they open when the raised lantern or a light move hits (widenInS quick, widenOutS slow); squint: the lids' close while it winds up to nip. drift: a slow bob (bobM at bobHz), a turn this way and that (turnDeg at turnHz), a breathing swell (breath, a share, at breathHz) and a loose swirl round the swarm's middle (swirlHz, its radius from the seeded members). tell: bunch up to tightShare of the swirl, squashing by squash, quivering quiverM at quiverHz. dart: stretch along its way by up to stretch at stretchMps; nip: a squash of nipSquash over nipS when a dart ends. scatter: a burst out to scatterShare of the swirl, away from the light, in burstS. follow: how fast each mote eases to where it should be (a share a second); offsetS: each mote's own lag behind the swarm, so they never move in lockstep. trail: smoky puffs behind a mote moving faster than fromMps (full at fullMps), puffs of them each sizeM wide, lasting lifeS, at alpha.

floors.note: H1, the floor maker (approved by Matt October 27, 2026; doc 16, A floor and How it is built). Read by src/world/hollow/plan.js, shapes.js, field.js, floor.js and walk-grid.js, and shown on tools/cave-lab.html; nothing in the game reads it until H3. depths: the four depths in order (id, name). level: a floor's level picks its depth; borders are the levels between depths, and within softLevels of a border either depth can come up (the chance slides across the band). flavors: the sponge takes the place of the depth's rock about share of floors from depth index fromDepth (0 is the wet shelf); the root halls wait for the island's tree count (a later piece), so their share is 0 until then. count: chambers on a floor, total from about total[0] at the wet shelf to total[1] in the glass halls (give or take jitter), split into a main path of main[0] to main[1] (the way in and the way down included) and side[0] to side[1] side chambers; seepShare: the chance of an oil seep among the side chambers, from seepFromDepth. layout: chambers acrossM wide, at least gapM of rock between any two, each next main chamber turned up to turnDeg off the last; floors rise or fall up to floorStepM between joined chambers, the main path drifting down by downM a chamber; tries: placements tried before the plan starts again. passage: rock gap between joined chambers (lengthM), the tube's radius, how far its middle bends to one side (bendM, so one chamber can't see into the next), how high its round middle sits over its flat floor (liftShare of the radius), its blend into the chambers (blendM), and how far apart unrelated passages must stay (clearM). wear: seeded noise on the rock, amountM high at scaleM across (fineM at fineScaleM for grain), much less on the floor (floorShare) up to wallFromM above it. mesh: the field is sampled every cellM over the floor's bounds plus marginM (cellM for refChambers chambers, coarser by the square root of how many more a floor has, up to maxCellM, and spongeCellShare coarser for the sponge's busier rock, or a depth's own shapes.cellShare, so a floor lands near 60k to 100k triangles), rock values clamped at clampM (only the surface matters), split into slabs for the workers. walk: the walk grid's cells, slope and step limits (as recipes/world/walker.json grid), the headroom a floor cell needs under the rock above, the up-facing share of a surface (upY, the normal's height) that counts as floor at all, wadeM (water deeper than this is not walkable), and retries: how many next seeds a floor may try when it is not walkable end to end. shapes: each depth's chamber shapes. heightM: floor to roof; blobs: how many blended ellipsoids make a chamber, spreadShare of its radius apart, blended over blendM, squash: how far the blobs flatten across. Wet shelf: shelves (raised flat rock, low ones steppable at lowM, high ones a ledge at highM, highShare of them high, sizeM across), puddles (hollows depthM deep, radiusM wide, waterM of water in them). Dripstone: columns (radiusM, kept doorClearM from the doorways), hanging stone (stalactites lengthM long, radiusM at the root), and floor stone (stalagmites). Silt deeps: long chambers (lengthShare longer, widthShare as wide), a channel down the middle (widthM, depthM, lengthShare of the chamber, water standing waterM below the floor), and causeways across it (count, widthM). Glass halls: faceted pockets (facets planes, offsetShare of the radius, each wall facet facing wallTiltDeg up from level and each of the four roof facets roofTiltDeg up (90 would be a flat roof), a second smaller pocket secondShare as wide, blended over blendM) and crystals (count, lengthM, radiusM, floorShare of them standing on the floor). sponge: a gyroid lattice through the chambers (periodM the cell size, thickness the strut level, thicker near walls by wallThicken, and thinned to bandLevel up to walkBandM over the floor, easing back over bandFadeM, so struts reach the floor only as slim pillars and the walker has headroom), the chambers widened by growShare and joined by fat tubes (joinRadiusM) instead of passages.
